d.note: Historic village hotel with a restaurant, tavern and brick-oven pizzeria.
d.fn: Built 1835; bills itself as the oldest grand hotel in Central New York

d.note: Hot dog stand serving Hofmann franks and coneys, with an ice cream parlor in its old bowling alley.
d.fn: Family meat market founded 1886; hot dog stand opened 1917; moved to this Liverpool spot in 1930 (its own history)

d.note: Manlius branch of the Utica-area bakery, bringing its half moons and tomato pie to Onondaga County.
d.fn: Its first NYSDOH inspection was on August 21, 2025, so it opened around then; exact opening date not confirmed.

d.note: Skaneateles inn, restaurant and tavern in a building that has hosted travelers since 1807.
d.fn: Built by Isaac Sherwood in 1807 as a stagecoach tavern; later Lamb's Hotel, Packwood House and Kan-Ya-To Inn before taking the Sherwood name again in 1945 (its own history)

d.note: Skaneateles dining room in business since 1899, now a farm-to-table restaurant.
d.fn: Founded in 1899 by Fred and Cora Krebs; later renovated under owner Kim Weitsman (I LOVE NY listing).

d.note: Irish pub on Tipperary Hill serving pub fare since 1890 by its own account.
d.fn: Claims 1890 at the corner of W. Fayette and Ulster streets and calls itself the city's oldest tavern

d.note: Syracuse pizzeria whose menu leads with its namesake tomato pie.
Syracuse Italian restaurant making its own pasta, with 'Wicked' chicken riggies on the menu and stretch bread from its bakery across the street.
Syracuse dim sum restaurant serving steamed dumplings, cold plates and house-made noodle soups. Closed Mondays.
Downtown Syracuse bagel shop started by a hometown couple. Its bagels are boiled, then finished in a wood-fired oven.
Oswego bagel shop open since 1989, known for homemade bagels and flavored cream cheeses such as banana pepper and bacon-horseradish.
d.fn: I LOVE NY says it opened in 1989. The year at this address isn't stated.

d.note: Oswego shop that makes its bagels from scratch every day. The dough is mixed, rested, rolled and cold-proofed before baking. NYSDOH lists it as River Walk Pizza & Bagel.
